target: M4/G16G local host through public Metal only
pinned_git_revision_note: recorded for provenance only; per repo convention this is NOT re-checked against live HEAD at capture time (the orchestrator commits sibling experiments continuously). Validity is keyed on authored_sha256 below, which run.py's 00_inputs.json records at every capture and verify.py enforces unchanged between run01 and run02.

boundary.apple_binary_archive_bo_or_compiled_shad: only our own compiled shader bytes, compiled at runtime from kernels/*.metal (OWN-SHADER)
boundary.apple_sdk_headers_read: Metal.framework public header files, for method signatures only -- standard SDK usage, not disassembly

gate_order: PRE_GPU: --selftest, --seqtest, run.py --build, run.py --smoke, verify.py --preflight, run.py --execute run01; RUN01_PRESENT: --selftest, --seqtest, verify.py --between-runs, run.py --execute run02; RUN02_PRESENT: analysis.py --write, make_manifest.py --write + --check, verify.py --captured
cross_run_comparison: gated sub-dicts byte-compared for every case whose exec_status is ok in both runs (verify.py compare_gated); a mismatch anywhere is a hard failure of verify.py --captured
no_nondeterministic_field_in_gated: structurally enforced: verify.py scans every captured record's gated sub-dict recursively against a banned-key/substring list (GPU addresses, absolute timestamps, wall-clock durations); GPU virtual addresses and raw timestamps are reported only under raw, never gated
